notes.title: ZomWick Demo LeaderBoard Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551826/3b668f074332a6549a05051839c3e0d3ba3bfd4f.png[/img]

We now show the leaderboard in the demo build, you can see how well or bad you have done without leaving the game.

notes.title: Build 1.0.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Sliding Car Of Doom", sorry but this is what you missed but don't worry we can always introduce similar bugs in the future!
[/list]
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/91up5d593c91xqno2nem0/Zomwick_3DbZegcEWG.gif?rlkey=rxz81ww5bwg2kgto83p0ei46z&dl=0[/img]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Electricity Tower.
[*]  Some players missed that they can move the towers in  "Sliding Tower Slots". Added some visual pointers to make it more clear.
[*]Reduced timer for basic controls helper so it does not show again if you already know the controls. 
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added  Zomwick's biggest enemy as a level ending animation.
[*] Adjusted Zomwick's model and position slightly.
[*] Fixed/Improved "Task Failed Successfully"   achievement.  It is now easier to achieve it. 
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.0.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog
[list]
[*]Increased performance in Main Menu
[*]Fixed "Resume Game" panel animation
[*]Reduced timer for Level "Cube 2". It is now possible to win without using "Tower Suicide" mechanics. 
[*] The bullet size has been increased, making it harder to miss ZomWick.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.52 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Change log

[list]
[*]     Fixed options menu and sound problems.
[*]    "Continue Game" button no longer opens options menu when you finish the game
[*]     Fixed some placement problems.
[*]     Various very small game balance changes in level times.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.46 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Change log
[list]
[*] Improved Tower Sliding Mechanics,  movement is no longer restricted by screen edges. 
[*] You can see which level you are playing currently from pause menu.
[*] Level selection menu now can go also backwards between prologues. 
[*] Various small bug fixes.
[*] Various very small game balance changes. 

[/list]
